meta.title: AI Hybrid Video Production — Pixtoon
meta.description: Commercial video production in as little as 3 days, from €1,000 for 20 sec. AI, animation and filmmaking in one pipeline, directed by humans. Pixtoon studio, Chișinău.

hero.lead: AI + animation + filmmaking, directed by people.
hero.highlight: A commercial in just 3 days. From €1,000 for 20 seconds.

title.a: AI is part of the pipeline.

process.lead: We combine traditional creative production with the newest AI tools to produce high-quality commercial content faster and more efficiently.

steps.title: Brief
steps.text: We learn the brand, the product, the objective and the audience.

steps.title: Concept
steps.text: Pixtoon develops the creative idea, the script and the visual direction.

steps.title: AI production
steps.text: AI accelerates characters, environments, product visuals and frames — wherever it opens up creative possibilities.

steps.title: Animation & post
steps.text: Our team handles animation, compositing, editing, voice, music, sound design and final finishing.

steps.title: Delivery
steps.text: Final video delivered for social, digital ads, YouTube, TV and DOOH.

included.lead: From the first brief to the final master — no middlemen, no handoffs, no surprises.

monthly.subtitle: Your AI content production team. Every month.
monthly.lead: Turn a campaign, a mascot, a product or a brand universe into a continuous stream of video. Instead of starting a new production from scratch every time, we build a visual system for the brand and keep producing new stories, situations and formats month after month.

custom.label: Custom monthly production
custom.title: For brands that need a higher volume of content or a production system of their own.

closing.text: The advantage of monthly production is not simply “more videos for less money”. It is continuity.
closing.text2: Once Pixtoon has developed the brand’s visual world — the characters or mascot, the visual style, the tone and the recurring formats — we can keep producing new content far faster and hold a consistent brand universe, month after month.

pricing.note: The final price and timeline depend on the complexity of the concept, the duration and the techniques required.

finalCta.lead: Tell us what you want to promote. We’ll recommend the smartest way to produce it.

caseStudy.solutionLead: How we combined filming, AI and post-production.

microinvest.lead: The Microinvest family characters were created the classic 3D way — fully modelled and rigged, ready for traditional animation. Now we animate them with AI tools, producing far more content, far faster, with the characters’ identity kept intact.

features.title: Characters built classically
features.text: The Microinvest family — modelled and rigged in 3D the traditional way, with full animation controllers.

features.title: Animation accelerated with AI
features.text: We now animate these characters with AI tools — much faster, much more content, without losing their identity.

features.title: Content volume
features.text: Reels, social spots, brand scenes — a character universe we can keep extending.

why.text: Characters built the classic way — with a full rig, expressions and controllers — have an identity and a consistency that AI alone cannot reproduce.
why.text2: Combining that base with AI animation, we produce new scenes, reactions, movements and stories at a pace traditional animation alone could not reach.
why.cta: See how we can do this for your brand
